rule: At the start of every task, evaluate the task against the parameters below, then load ONLY the skills whose triggers match your evaluation. Never load all skills.

parameters.name: work_type
parameters.description: The kind of backend work this task is.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: How much code does this task span?

skills.purpose: Stable API/interface contracts: REST/GraphQL, type boundaries, module seams.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is api_design or when you are designing/changing a public interface or module boundary.

skills.purpose: Deep-module vocabulary for well-bounded units and testable seams.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is architecture or when structuring modules or finding seams.

skills.purpose: Shared domain language and model clarity (glossary, terminology).
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is domain_modeling or when defining/shaping the domain model.

skills.purpose: Ground implementation in official documentation; authoritatively sourced patterns.
skills.triggers: Load when you must verify an approach against official docs before implementing.
Load when work_type is schema_change (adding columns, indexes, backfills, table changes).

skills.purpose: Expand/contract migration, rename/drop, and system sunset workflows.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is deprecation (removing/renaming APIs, systems, features).

skills.purpose: Profiling-driven optimization: queries, latency, N+1s, load.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is performance or when you suspect slow queries/latency.

skills.purpose: Logging, metrics, tracing, alerting for diagnosable production behavior.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is observability or when shipping a feature that must be diagnosable in production.
Load when work_type is debugging (tests fail, build broke, behavior regressed).

skills.purpose: Structured diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions.
skills.triggers: Load when a hard bug or performance regression is reported.
Load when work_type is code_review or when reviewing code before it stands.
Load when work_type is refactor and the code is harder to read than it should be.

skills.purpose: Behavioral guardrails: avoid overcomplication, surgical changes, surface assumptions.
skills.triggers: Always load when writing new code.

skills.purpose: Keep the project's written quality bar from being lowered.
skills.triggers: Load when the project has a written quality bar and the change could weaken it (coverage, perf, types).

skills.purpose: Deliver changes in thin, verifiable slices.
skills.triggers: Load when scope is multi_file or whole_service, or when the change feels large.

skills.purpose: Clean history, atomic commits, branching, PR hygiene.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is git (committing, branching, opening a PR, releasing).
Load when work_type is ci_cd (setting up/modifying build & deployment pipelines).

skills.purpose: Record architecture decisions (ADRs) and decision documentation.
skills.triggers: Load when work_type is decision_recording or when making an architectural choice that should be recorded.
